dimensions.detail: The skill's commands, templates, vault layout, checkpoint/recover workflow, search, migration, and auto-linking all fit the stated purpose of structured agent memory. It intentionally stores work context, relationships, decisions, and notes, which can be sensitive but is disclosed and central to the feature.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime actions are user-directed and documented. Bulk migration and link-all operations can modify many markdown files, but the artifact describes dry-run, backup, rollback, and verification paths.

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a global npm CLI and optional qmd installation from GitHub via bun. This is coherent for a CLI/search integration, but users must trust those external packages because their implementation is outside the supplied skill artifacts.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

All commands and instructions in SKILL.md are clearly aligned with the stated purpose of memory management, including features like vault initialization, memory storage, search, and migration (e.g., from OpenClaw vaults).
